review_candidates.description: ROLE OVERVIEW The General Manager, Cloud & Infrastructure Engineering provides enterprise-wide strategic and operational leadership across cloud, infrastructure, platform engineering, and technology operations. The role is accountable for building secure, resilient, scalable, and cost-efficient technology foundations that enable business growth, regulatory compliance, and digital transformation. This leader owns the operating model and governance for hybrid and multi-cloud environments, technology resilience, FinOps, solution architecture, technical program delivery, DevOps, Release Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), and Cloud Platform Engineering. As the enterprise subject matter expert for disaster recovery, modernization, and infrastructure transformation, the role advises senior leadership and represents Technology at management committees/forums and Board Committees. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES CLOUD & INFRASTRUCTURE LEADERSHIP Defines a compelling technology vision and converts it into prioritized roadmaps, investment cases, operating models, and measurable outcomes aligned with business and regulatory priorities. Executes on the enterprise cloud and infrastructure strategy, roadmap, and target operating model, aligned with business priorities, regulatory obligations, cybersecurity requirements, and transformation goals. Design and institutionalize secure hybrid and multi-cloud architectures, including production and disaster recovery environments, network integration, platform standards, observability, automation, and resilience controls. Serve as a trusted advisor to the Chief Technology Officer and senior leadership, proactively identifying systemic, operational, regulatory, financial, and talent risks that may affect resilience or delivery. OPERATIONAL RESILIENCE & CONTINUITY Own the reliability, availability, capacity, performance, and security of enterprise infrastructure and cloud services, supported by effective 24x7 operations, monitoring, incident response, and service management. Establish and govern disaster recovery, business continuity, backup, recovery, and resilience-testing capabilities across hybrid environments, ensuring that recovery objectives are measurable and regularly validated. Monitor service-level practices, including SRE principles and continuous improvement. GOVERNANCE & REGULATORY COMPLIANCE Ensure compliance with BNM RMiT, MOF CRA, ISMS, and other applicable regulatory and control frameworks through robust architecture standards, policies, controls, evidence, and governance routines. Provide concise, decision-ready reporting to senior leadership, executive committees, Board Committees, and the Board on risk posture, service health, resilience readiness, investment priorities, and remediation progress. RISK & AUDIT READINESS Own proactive technology risk management, control effectiveness, continuous compliance monitoring, audit readiness, and timely remediation of findings to sustain regulator confidence and operational integrity. Applies strong knowledge of ITSM, technology risk, service assurance, regulatory compliance, internal controls, audit, and Three Lines of Defence frameworks. Chair and strengthen technology governance forums to enforce architectural integrity, disciplined decision-making, accountable approvals, exception management, and transparent risk ownership. FINANCIAL STEWARDSHIP Own infrastructure and cloud financial stewardship, including budgeting, forecasting, unit-cost transparency, FinOps, procurement optimization, vendor performance, licensing, and cloud expenditure governance. Supports the Chief Technology Officer with the communication of board-ready financial and investment insights. TEAM DEVELOPMENT Builds inclusive, accountable, high-performing multidisciplinary teams; develops leadership depth and succession; and collaborates effectively across business, technology, cybersecurity, risk, audit, procurement, and external partners. Coaches multidisciplinary teams, strengthening cloud-native, platform engineering, DevOps, TechOps, SRE, automation, and AI/ML capabilities. WHAT DOES IT TAKE TO BE SUCCESSFUL Qualifications Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. Relevant IT service management certification, such as ITIL Foundation, Intermediate, or Managing Professional. Professional cloud certification in AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform; advanced architecture certification is preferred. Project or program management certification, such as Agile, PMP or PRINCE2, is an advantage. Work Experience At least 12 years of progressive experience across technology infrastructure, cloud engineering, platform operations, and technology governance, including a minimum of 3 years in a senior technology leadership role. Strong track record in financial services or another highly regulated industry, with practical experience applying BNM RMiT or comparable regulatory requirements. Demonstrated technical depth in AWS, GitLab, Terraform, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, observability, automation, and hybrid cloud operating models. Proven delivery of complex disaster recovery, resilience engineering, microservices, technology-stack migration, data centre or cloud modernization, and transformation program. Proven accountability for 24x7 technology operations across business-critical multi-cloud and hybrid production environments, including major incident and problem management. Knowledge, Skills & Competencies Strategic Leadership — Able to translate business and regulatory priorities into clear cloud, infrastructure and platform strategies, roadmaps, investment cases, operating models, and measurable outcomes. Technical & Architectural Depth — Demonstrates broad expertise across hybrid and multi-cloud platforms, operating systems, databases, networks, cybersecurity controls, automation, observability, infrastructure as code, and cloud-native architecture. Operational Resilience — Strong application of advanced knowledge of high-availability engineering, disaster recovery, business continuity, capacity management, incident and problem management, SRE, and 24x7 operational practices. Governance, Risk & Compliance — Possesses strong knowledge of ITSM, technology risk, service assurance, internal controls, audit, Three Lines of Defense, BNM RMiT, ISMS, and related regulatory frameworks. Commercial & Financial Acumen — Demonstrates sound judgement in budgeting, forecasting, FinOps, procurement, vendor and contract management, licensing, cost optimization, and technology investment prioritization. Delivery & Transformation — Leads complex modernization and transformation portfolios using disciplined program governance, agile delivery, DevOps, release engineering, dependency management, and benefits realization. Executive Communication & Influence — Communicates complex technology, risk, and investment matters with clarity; provides concise, decision-ready recommendations to technical teams, senior leadership, regulators, Board Committees, and the Board.

Thu thập log, timeline, cung cấp thông tin liên quan để hỗ trợ DevOps – Middle thực hiện RCA (Root Cause Analysis) và postmortem. Quản lý & theo dõi tài nguyên Theo dõi hiệu năng EC2/ECS/RDS/S3, tổng hợp báo cáo định kỳ (tuần/tháng). Theo dõi trạng thái SQS queues (DLQ, visibility timeout, FIFO deduplication, scale consumer) theo hướng dẫn và cảnh báo khi vượt ngưỡng. Theo dõi Lambda functions theo hướng dẫn: timeout, memory, connection pooling, concurrency. Theo dõi batch job time, dung lượng S3/RDS, cảnh báo khi vượt ngưỡng. Kinh nghiệm sử dụng và vận hành thực tế với các dịch vụ AWS sau: ECS/Fargate, EC2, VPC networking S3, EventBridge, Lambda, SQS (Standard/FIFO) RDS MySQL : hiểu cấu trúc schema, thực hiện query cơ bản IAM, KMS : quản lý quyền truy cập, least-privilege CloudWatch : theo dõi metrics, logs, alarms, dashboards Biết lập trình Python hoặc Node.js để viết script hỗ trợ vận hành. review_candidates.description: L2 Support Engineer Working arrangement : Onsite Location: Indonesia Salary Range : 15-20% Increment Job Overview We are looking for a technically skilled L2 Application Support Engineer to provide second-level technical support, troubleshoot application issues, and ensure the smooth operation of business applications. The successful candidate will be responsible for investigating and resolving technical incidents escalated from the L1 support team, performing root cause analysis, supporting application maintenance, and coordinating with development and infrastructure teams to resolve complex issues. The ideal candidate should have a good understanding of application support, databases, troubleshooting, and incident management processes. Key Responsibilities Provide Level 2 technical support for business applications and systems. Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve application incidents and technical issues escalated by the L1 support team. Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and identify recurring application issues. Monitor application performance and system health to ensure service availability and stability. Analyse application logs, error messages, and database records to identify and resolve issues. Perform basic SQL queries, database checks, and data validation when required. Support application configuration, maintenance, patching, and minor enhancements. Escalate complex technical issues to the L3 support or development team with detailed findings. Work closely with developers, infrastructure, database administrators, and other technical teams to resolve incidents. Manage incident tickets, service requests, and problem records in accordance with SLA requirements. Perform application testing and validation after bug fixes, patches, and system changes. Prepare and maintain technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge base articles. Participate in system releases, deployment activities, and production support. Ensure incidents are resolved within the agreed service level agreements (SLAs). Requirements & Qualifications Diploma or Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field. 2–5 years of experience in IT or application support. Previous experience in Level 2 (L2) application support or technical support is preferred. Good understanding of application troubleshooting and incident management. Basic knowledge of SQL and database troubleshooting. Familiarity with operating systems such as Windows and/or Linux. Understanding of application architecture, web applications, and client-server environments. Experience with ticketing tools such as JIRA, ServiceNow, or similar platforms. Knowledge of ITIL processes, incident management, and problem management is an advantage. Good analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross-functional teams. Technical Skills (Added Advantage) SQL / Oracle / Microsoft SQL Server Java / C++ / C# / PHP Angular / HTML / JavaScript REST API / Postman Linux / Windows Server Microsoft Azure / Azure DevOps Git / GitHub Application monitoring and log analysis tools Preferred Candidate Profile Hands-on experience supporting enterprise applications or business-critical systems. Able to investigate technical issues independently rather than simply forwarding tickets. Comfortable working in a production support environment. Able to communicate technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Willing to participate in shift rotations or after-hours support if required.
